newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London steady, watch Wall St.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London steady, watch Wall St.

text.p: Hong Kong shares were holding on to modest gains in afternoon London trading with attention on U.S. markets and the prospects for interest rates at next week's Federal Reserve Open Market Committee meeting, traders said.
"Overnight the tone has been pretty mixed and having had the euphoria about U.S. rates perhaps being kept steady, now there are concerns about a 1/4 point rise," said one trader.
Business was quiet in London with traders anticipating activity would take its lead from New York through the afternoon.
By 1344 GMT, the Hang Seng London Reference index was 5.96 points higher at 11,592.64.
Overnight, shares cut morning losses but finished lower on continued worries over U.S. interest rates and weakness of the U.S. dollar.
The Hang Seng index ended 7.35 points lower at 11,586.68.
